visual.general_description: Scanned grayscale multichannel EEG tracing with twelve scalp channels, EOG and ECG rows.
visual.detailed_description: A gray-background printout of fourteen stacked horizontal traces labelled at left Fp1-A1, Fp2-A1, F3-A1, F4-A1, C3-A1, C4-A1, P3-A1, P4-A1, O1-A1, O2-A1, T3-A1, T4-A1, EOG and ECG. Most scalp traces show low-to-moderate amplitude, irregular mixed-frequency activity with many closely spaced small waves; C3-A1 and C4-A1 are flatter than the frontal and temporal rows, and T4-A1 shows somewhat larger rhythmic waves. One slow downward dip is visible near the horizontal middle of several frontal and parietal rows. The EOG row shows slow undulations. The ECG row shows regular narrow upward deflections at roughly even spacing along the strip. Small rectangular pulse marks appear on the bottom baseline at the far left and right of centre. No time scale, amplitude scale, patient name or date is printed.
